evals.prompt: Audit the backend of this Next.js 16 repo — API routes, lib folder, and whether page data should go through a repository. We're on Resend only, no database yet. Write findings to docs.
evals.expected_output: Structured audit in docs/BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md with topology, boundaries, caching, and API consistency findings.

evals.prompt: Refactor src/app/api/send-diagnostic/route.ts — it duplicates rate limiting and inlines Resend. Unify with the other form endpoints and move business logic to core/services.
evals.expected_output: Thin route using shared POST handler; diagnostic submission in core/services; shared rate limiter.

evals.prompt: Our marketing pages import @/content/site everywhere. Propose and implement a page data layer so sitemap and dynamic [slug] routes use repositories/cache while keeping content/ as the source files.
evals.expected_output: src/core/repositories and src/core/cache with sitemap wired to repository; RSC dynamic routes use cached getters.
